name: mantle of spell resistance
desc: Harvested from the deep-trench sycophants of the Underdark, the *mantle of spell resistance* is a shivering, violet membrane that must be grafted directly onto a host’s bare nervous system. As it feeds greedily on the wearer's vitality, its micro-cilia reach outward to catch and devour incoming arcane currents before they can pierce the flesh. To wear this living material is to exist in a suffocating, magic-deaf silence, where even the whispers of the gods are drowned out by the parasite's low, ecstatic hum.
